title: sequence-distribution-driven-kv-policy-generator
creator: Priya Kapoor
description: Problem: When onboarding new open models we need deterministic, reproducible recommendations for a KV cache policy (pin duration, eviction class, retention window) that reflect the model's sequence-length distribution and tail behavior. Current onboarding pipelines produce static profiles that are brittle for models with multi-modal sequence distributions (chat + code + long documents), and reviewers manually tune pin settings based on ad-hoc metrics. This ticket adds a generation pipeline that consumes sampled request traces and model microbenchmarks and emits a 'KV policy artifact' containing: (1) per-sequence-length retention probability buckets, (2) pin-recommendation with confidence score, (3) expected cost/latency delta if applied, and (4) a simulated eviction outcome report for the fleet mix.
acceptance_criteria: A reproducible CLI (or job) that takes a model identifier + 10k sampled sequences and outputs a KV policy JSON artifact with the fields: bucketed_seq_distribution, pin_recommendation, confidence_score (0-100), simulated_cost_delta, simulated_latency_delta, and recommended_retention_ms.
Policy artifacts validated against a holdout 2k sequences: applying recommended policy in the simulator yields >= 70% of predicted latency improvement and <= 10% deviation in token cost estimate.
Artifacts are persisted to model-catalog with versioned name and UI hooks in Console so PMs/Design can preview recommendations before pinning rollout.
Unit and integration tests for the core bucketing and simulator (coverage for edge cases: bimodal distributions, heavy tails, short-only models).
Migration path: for 3 pilot models (one chat, one code, one long-document), an ops-safe rollout is documented and executed with canary monitor dashboards enabled.
implementation_notes: 1) Data ingestion: add a job to sample per-model request distributions from prod telemetry (sampled prefix length, prompt length, total generation length). Sampling code must avoid PII—use hashed IDs and discard text.
2) Bucketing logic: implement log-spaced and quantile bucketing options. Default = adaptive quantile bucketing with 10 buckets, plus special tail bucket for sequences > 95th percentile.

3) Pin recommendation: compute expected KV-hit-rate curves per bucket using microbenchmarks for model token throughput. Derive expected latency/cost benefit per ms pinned and score a 'pin-duration' sweep (0s, 10s, 30s, 2min, 10min). Assign confidence by bootstrap sampling of traces.

4) Simulator: reuse existing eviction simulator but extend to accept mixed workload (relative weight per bucket) and simulate time-series of requests for 24h to estimate steady-state hit rate and eviction churn.
5) Artifact storage: persist artifacts under model-catalog as artifacts/<model>/<version>/kv-policy-v2.json and emit metadata tags for pin-allowed (boolean) and lock-recommended (boolean).
6) Console integration: small preview panel showing bucket histogram, recommended pin and tradeoff chart (latency vs cost). RSVP with Design to prototype UI.
7) Safety: add a pre-flight check that refuses a pin recommendation if simulated_peak_memory > node_capacity * 0.9 unless override flag set by ops.
8) Observability: emit metric kvcache.policy.generator.duration and kvcache.policy.simulator.error_rate; log sample seed and artifact checksum for reproducibility.
rollout_plan: Stage 0 (dev): unit tests + run on archived traces for three internal models. Complete by 2025-02-11.

Stage 1 (canary): generate artifacts and apply pin policy as read-only (no enforcement) for 3 pilot models; compare predicted vs observed cache hit/latency for 48h. Monitor with new dashboard panel. Expected completion: 2025-02-18.
Stage 2 (soft-enforce): enable pin enforcement for low-traffic shards for one pilot model, observe for 72h, rollback if tail latency regresses beyond SLO or memory breaches threshold.
Stage 3 (general): automatic artifact publish to model-catalog + UI approvals for PM/Design; then expose pin suggestion API to onboarding workflow.
qa_testing: Smoke: run generator against synthetic workloads that emulate chat/code/long-document mixes; validate bucket shapes and pin sweep outputs.
Regression: compare new simulator outputs against ground-truth simulator used in ENG-51230 for identical inputs; <10% variance.
Performance: policy generator job should complete for 10k samples in < 6 minutes on staging runner (m5-large equiv.); simulator 24h sim should complete < 3 minutes with vectorized workload generator.
Security: code path for sampling must strip user payload and only include sequence lengths and hashed IDs. Confirm with Security team checklist.
monitoring_and_metrics: KPIs to track during canary: kvcache.hit_rate_by_bucket (per model), api.latency.p50/p95/p99 for canary shards, token_cost.delta_estimated_vs_actual, kvcache.eviction_rate.
Alert conditions: p95 latency increase > 10% vs baseline for canary model OR simulated_peak_memory breach > 90% => immediate rollback.
Long-term: baseline model-level KPIs stored weekly to validate pin recommendations over time and detect model drift in sequence distribution.
Dashboard links: placeholder dashboards will be created under Dashboards/Onboarding/KV-Policy-Generator (PR will include link).
Instrumentation: every artifact generation should emit artifact_checksum and sample_seed as tags to ease debugging/replay.
